body:
## Problem

Replay controllers could retain a worker failure without the reason known at the parse, creation or timeout detector. Human logs could not reliably recover those facts, and incomplete worker reporting needed to remain distinguishable from successful completion.

## What changes

Adds private, stable scalar reason events with explicit known-context bits, bounded framing and startup version negotiation on Linux and Windows. Actual parse, creation and no-progress paths emit their facts; controllers retain events by worker attempt and preserve loss, unsupported context and missing-final uncertainty. Startup decoding checks explicit bytes and complete lines before replay.

Adds producer, stream and real-process controller regression coverage, original-header compatibility callers, protocol documentation and an Unreleased changelog entry.

## Why this matters

Controllers can distinguish reported causes with worker prose disabled, while absent raw errors, resource identities and completion evidence stay unknown. Earlier failed-attempt evidence remains available after a successful retry.

## Why this approach

The bounded private transport extends the existing worker pipes without changing public parse/ExternalReplayer declarations, shared progress layout or legacy message meanings. Originating detectors supply reasons directly; native termination and timeout-delivery facts remain separate evidence.

## Verification and limits

Candidate: `8a47fc863d72f06c7e0ec3dc380697a8a351724c`; base: `4ea747ffa215f8057d12aa5525ba0e4497961e7d`.

Independent unit checking passed four Linux CPU configurations (Debug/Release, exceptions OFF/ON), 252/252 tests each; 82 event/timeout/fork tests repeated three times; and 20 focused ASan+UBSan tests. It also passed the unchanged startup-defect probe, the actual CLI binary-input corpus, original-header callers, and both compiled semantic sensitivity controls.

A separate final checker independently passed the same four fresh 252/252-test configurations; 69 planned controller/timeout/fork tests repeated three times (207 executions); 20 ASan+UBSan cases; actual base-header callers; the 38-input production startup corpus; and the unchanged original startup-defect probe. All eight final gates and all eleven planned case mappings were accepted with no new findings.

[Final checker report](https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/harness-artifacts/runs/issue-18/issue18-20261102/reports/check-final-1.json) · [Unit checker report](https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/harness-artifacts/runs/issue-18/issue18-20261102/reports/check-unit-2.json).

Native Windows verification was explicitly skipped at the user's request and remains unverified. This is bounded Linux CPU and compatibility evidence; no GPU, Steam, cache-persistence, complete parser-security or general binary ABI guarantee is claimed.

## Task references

Closes https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/issues/18

Shared requirements: https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/issues/8 (parent remains open).
